explanation: The upper plane contributes x. For the lower hemisphere h=1−√(9−x²−y²), h_x=x/√(9−x²−y²), and its downward outward orientation gives integrand (−y)h_x−x=−xy/√(9−x²−y²)−x. Adding cancels the x terms, giving e. All choices integrate to zero by symmetry over D, but e is the directly derived flux integrand.
